title: 简单句练习
description: 简短完整的英文句子，注意大小写与句末标点。

content.text:
The cat sat on the mat.
I like to read books at night.
She goes to school by bus every day.
He is my best friend.
We play games after dinner.
The sun rises in the east.
Please close the door behind you.
My mother makes the best soup in town.
